title: Going where the work is
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
How far would you be willing to move for a better job?
What matters more when deciding whether to relocate: salary, career growth, family, or quality of life?
Should employers help workers with housing and relocation costs?
Is moving for work easier when you are young, or does personality matter more than age?
What would make you reject an excellent job in another city or country?
